title: The spawn guard refuses a model below a role's row too, not only above it, so a round 2 reviewer cannot run on haiku
why: Sighting, coordinator 04:19 CST Nov 14 (the lane's own words, relayed; unchecked by triage): lane records-page-before-ready ran a round 2 reviewer on haiku (rounds from 2 on run Sonnet) and no guard refused it, while a Sonnet round 1 in lane test-helper-has-a-home was refused as above the role's model. So the model guard blocks above-role but not below-role in round 2. Effect: a round 2 verdict from a model that should not have run it; the lane named it and the coordinator told it to run a fresh round. Related, by title only: spawn-model-cap-all-roles (caps every role, not only builders) and decision agent-model-cap (the model-per-role table). Check idea (unbuilt): a spawn whose model is not the row's model, in either direction, is refused or asked. SIGHTING 06:10 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:10, relayed): in round 1 of lane fast-checks-before-ready the test-author and reviewer ran haiku, because model:sonnet is refused for those roles; agents/*.md read `model: haiku` (lane, as data; triage did not read the files or the refusal).
note: Filed 04:20 CST Nov 14 by triage. Unstarted. Not read: guard code. Whether a lower model on a row that says Sonnet is meant to be allowed (a cost saving) is not stated in anything triage read; the table is the owner's record, so the lane should read it before building.
